title: "de Bruijn Graphs and Eulerian Paths"

## Core Question

Why does assembly become an Eulerian path problem?

## Lesson Scaffold

- Define nodes as $(k-1)$-mers and edges as $k$-mers.
- State Eulerian path conditions.
- Present Hierholzer's algorithm conceptually.
- Analyze complexity in terms of the number of k-mers.
